         7       Legislative Resolution Number 4702,

         8       commemorating Good Joes Day, 2008.

         9                  "WHEREAS, Saint Joseph is

        10       everyone's patron saint, and not just the

        11       patron saint of those who are fortunate to

        12       bear his name; and

        13                  "WHEREAS, The New York State

        14       Legislature is appreciative of the vital

        15       contributions of those good members known as

        16       'Joseph'; and

        17                  "WHEREAS, The Society of Good Joes

        18       is celebrating its fiftieth year in memory of

        19       the late Joseph Addonizio, and its members

        20       have banded together under a common name in

        21       the spirit of camaraderie and good fellowship;

        22       and

        23                  "WHEREAS, Tradition holds that

        24       Saint Joseph is the patron saint of the

        25       working person, of all those who labor with



                      Candyco Transcription Service, Inc.

         1       the dignity that only true humility imparts;

         2       and

         3                  "WHEREAS, On Saint Joseph's Day in

         4       March, the swallows return to Capistrano,

         5       heralding the conclusion of a long, cold

         6       winter and the advent of a new spring; now,

         7       therefore, be it

         8                  "RESOLVED, That this Legislative

         9       Body pause in its deliberations and recognize

        10       this great day, Wednesday, March 19, 2008, in

        11       commemoration and deliberation of all

        12       Good Joes in the State of New York, which will

        13       be celebrated by the members of the

        14       Legislature on Thursday, March 27, 2008, in

        15       honor of all the Good Joes of this Empire

        16       State."
